first_week.eligible_universe: all Mondays from 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-29 excluding candidate-02 weeks already used or publicly opened
first_week.selection_method: Python random.Random(seed).choice over chronologically sorted eligible Mondays

locked_hypothesis.absorbed_exhaustion: same-direction aggressive flow persists while price impact decays, the first packet midpoint is reclaimed and spot or basis fails to confirm
locked_hypothesis.continuation_invalidation: the second packet adverse extreme plus 0.10 lagged ATR
locked_hypothesis.continuation_objective: 1.25 times the completed first-packet displacement from the observed entry
locked_hypothesis.event_clock: non-overlapping packets close when completed aggressive quote turnover reaches a multiple of the lagged prior-24-hour median one-minute turnover
locked_hypothesis.regime_seed: a first packet must have unusually persistent signed flow, an aligned price move and high path efficiency relative only to prior packets
locked_hypothesis.retained_discovery: a second same-direction packet continues price impact, basis-adjusted spot confirms, basis expansion does not dominate and front-side depth does not materially refill
locked_hypothesis.reversal_invalidation: the combined two-packet extreme plus 0.10 lagged ATR
locked_hypothesis.target_selection_rule: never skip a nearer causal objective merely to raise reward/risk

promotion_rule: central u8 and at least one adjacent u6/u10 must pass every original weekly gate; any component with at least two trades must have nonnegative after-cost expectancy; otherwise execute exactly one predeclared core ablation on the same week

research_basis.implication: information time should be defined by market activity rather than fixed wall-clock intervals
research_basis.reference: Ane and Geman (2000), Order Flow, Transaction Clock, and Normality of Asset Returns

research_basis.implication: persistent order flow arises from split large orders and price-impact behavior changes by flow regime
research_basis.reference: Tsaknaki, Lillo and Mazzarisi (2025), Online learning of order flow and market impact with Bayesian change-point detection

research_basis.implication: impact permanence separates informed flow from temporary execution pressure
research_basis.reference: Donier and Bonart, A million metaorder analysis of Bitcoin

research_basis.implication: displacement and imbalance are confirmations inside a scenario, not standalone entry patterns
research_basis.reference: ICT 2022 mentorship material on displacement, imbalance and dealing ranges

single_ablation.implementation: set maximum_front_depth_refill to 1000.0 while all event-clock, impact, spot, basis, entry, stop, objective, cost and risk variables remain unchanged
single_ablation.reason: depth refill is a conditional quality feature inherited from v77 and must not be allowed to hide a viable endogenous-clock event rate
